properties.site-address: Former Lace Works, Derby Road Barnstaple EX32 7HA
properties.notes: Site is in close proximity to Barnstaple town centre. Development opportunities could include conversion of some of the more traditional buildings, including the Grade II listed building plus an element of demolition and rebuild of the more modern industrial buildings. Avoid development within the flood zone. 71058: Listed Building Consent for partial demolition of areas of the Lace Works assessed to have little or no heritage significance to enable future works. Approved 28/02/20
